query:
SELECT b.id, b.studentId, b.mentorId, u.name as studentName, u2.name as mentorName, b.status, b.createdAt
FROM bookings b
JOIN users u ON b.studentId = u.id
JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON b.mentorId = mp.id
JOIN users u2 ON mp.userId = u2.id
WHERE u.email = 'test-mentee@test.com' AND u2.name = '이윤호'
ORDER BY b.createdAt DESC;
